_doc: Shared cases for lib/stamped.py and dashboard/electron/main/stamped.js (marvin#1223): both run every case, so the two readers can't drift. now is 2026-11-10T12:00:00Z. mtime is the file's modified time (seconds since the epoch), used only for a legacy file with no generated_at.

cases.name: exactly at tolerance is not stale
one second past tolerance is stale
alive_at newer than generated_at keeps a quiet copy current
a future generated_at is age 0, flagged, never negative
legacy file: no host, dated by its own generated_at, default tolerance
legacy file with no time at all is dated by mtime
a garbled time is unknown age and stale
epoch-milliseconds alive_at (the github feed's form) is understood
